description: Real QEMU-generated device tree blob for the canonical Phase 3 `virt` machine, normalised to canonical FDT layout. Committed as a bounded teaching fixture; regenerate with scripts/dump_virt_dtb.sh.
normalisation: re-serialised in canonical FDT layout by scripts/fdtlib_min.py; tree verified semantically identical to the raw dump by scripts/dt_roundtrip_check.py

cross_validation.tool: dtc 1.7.0 (built from the dtc v1.7.0 release tarball)
cross_validation.check: dtc -I dtb -O dts on the normalised artifact reproduces the same tree as the raw dump, modulo the two randomised chosen seed properties

canonical_baseline.note: The artifact is a real QEMU-generated DTB, but it was produced by an ACTUAL-HOST ALTERNATE (11.1.0-git) rather than the canonical pinned 11.1.1 runtime. The tree structure for `virt,highmem=off,gic-version=2` / `cortex-a7` / `512M` / 1 CPU is stable across 11.1.x, but that stability is asserted by inspection of the two versions, NOT verified by running the canonical build. Regenerate and re-diff before claiming canonical-runtime evidence.

evidence.dtb_generation: VERIFIED -- the artifact was produced by executing qemu-system-arm
evidence.dtb_parse_and_semantics: VERIFIED -- scripts/validate_dt_semantics.py passes 84 invariants on this artifact
evidence.dtc_roundtrip: VERIFIED -- dtc 1.7.0 decompiles the artifact and recompiles it to a semantically identical tree
evidence.runtime_sysfs_correlation: UNVERIFIED -- no ARM kernel/rootfs was built or booted on the authoring host
